images.name: companion_fusion_evolutions
images.prompt: A truly hand-painted 2D video game sprite atlas with fully transparent alpha, showing two original fused CAT companions, not just reskinned existing cats: an ANGLER+TRAPPER hybrid carrying a living net turret with mechanical fishing lures and distinctive dual-cat partnership, and a SCOUT+SNIPER hybrid long-range lookout rig with telescopic periscope and visible cat crew. Two action states each: walking/aiming, hooking/launching. Four coherent separated poses in a square 2x2 grid, mobile readability, distinctive bodies, fine painted mechanical details, whimsical expressive feline survival game art, no labels, backgrounds, frame borders or watermarks.

images.name: weather_city_biome_atlas

Each biome has distinct cover, light pools and puddles reflecting possible gameplay visibility and AI adaptations. Carefully textured painterly source art, readable mobile 48-96px, no text, no UI, no watermark or screenshot frame.
